policies.single_player_heal: Aqua Arrow heals the player in this single-player game; no invented multiplayer support.
policies.proc_boundary: successful normal hit/incoming damage only; no VFX-driven damage, no nested or duplicate proc per ICD
policies.toggle_off: free control operation; no cast, cost, cooldown refresh or proc. Dignity OFF retains paid single-target proc by design.
policies.toggle_lifetime: Dignity official 1200 seconds; unknown Shooting/Bloody durations local 1800; expiry/death turns area/proc toggle off
policies.summon: Elemental Guardian uses existing bounded guardian movement/strike/save with school elemental area hits; no original creature art claim
policies.zero_fields: Passive manual MP/cooldown and non-applicable HP/power are explicit local defaults, never claimed official hyphen=0. Active casts have positive MP and proc attacks have positive MP/material costs.
